narrative: A fibre cut is most likely on AGG-07 (83% confidence). 41 valid alarms and 12 noise alarms were seen; packet loss on AGG-07 rose 38 points. Reroute via the backup path and dispatch a crew.

runbook.title: Fibre cut on aggregation uplink
runbook.excerpt: Confirm loss of signal on both ends, reroute traffic to the backup path, raise a field ticket.
